name: gizza-ai/qr-code-generator
summary: Generate a QR code (SVG or PNG).

tool.description: Generate a QR code as an SVG or PNG image from text, a URL, Wi-Fi credentials, a contact card, an email, an SMS, a phone number, or a location. Set content to text (encode the data string), url (encode data as a link; https:// is prepended if no scheme), wifi (build a WIFI: join code from ssid/password/security/hidden — scanning offers to connect), contact (build a vCard from name/phone/email/organization/url), email (build a mailto: from email/subject/body), sms (build an SMSTO: from phone/body), phone (build a tel: from phone), or geo (build a geo: from latitude/longitude). Choose format svg (default, scalable) or png (raster; size sets the pixel edge, 64-2048). error_correction is L/M/Q/H (default M). dark_color/light_color recolour the code (#rgb or #rrggbb). Returns an image. Runs locally — the data never leaves the device.

content.description: What to encode: text (any string), url (a link; a scheme is added if missing), wifi (join code from ssid/password/security), contact (a vCard from name/phone/email), email (a mailto: from email/subject/body), sms (an SMSTO: from phone/body), phone (a tel: from phone), or geo (a geo: from latitude/longitude).

data.description: The text or URL to encode (used when content is text or url).

password.description: Wi-Fi password (content=wifi; required for WPA/WEP, omit for nopass).

security.description: Wi-Fi security type (content=wifi): WPA (default, covers WPA/WPA2/WPA3), WEP, or nopass (open).

hidden.description: Set true if the Wi-Fi SSID is hidden (content=wifi).

phone.description: Phone number — contact (content=contact), recipient (content=sms), or number to dial (content=phone).

format.description: Output image format: svg (scalable, default) or png (raster, sized by the size param).

error_correction.description: Error-correction level: L (~7%), M (~15%, default), Q (~25%), or H (~30%). Higher survives more damage but makes a denser code.

size.description: PNG image edge in pixels (64-2048; ignored for svg).
